description: This Java class 'BlockedNamespaces' manages distributed data for blocking message addresses in specific namespaces within an Akka cluster, utilizing Akka's Distributed Data module with an ORSet to track blocked namespaces.

classes.name: BlockedNamespaces
classes.description: Manages distributed blocking of namespaces in an Akka cluster using an ORSet.

classes.name: Provider
classes.description: Provides instances of BlockedNamespaces with specific configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Returns an instance of BlockedNamespaces with default configuration for a given ActorSystem.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BlockedNamespaces with a custom configuration.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a namespace is stored in the local replica.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a namespace to all replicas.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a namespace from all replicas.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key used for the distributed ORSet.

methods.name: writeAll
methods.description: Creates a write consistency object for propagating updates.
